# DoorLine Manufacturers

> DoorLine Manufacturers is an aluminium handles manufacturer and wholesaler in Lahore, Pakistan. It makes aluminium door handles, cabinet handles, window locks, hinges and fittings, runs its own anodizing and electroplating, and supplies shops, fabricators, dealers and contractors across Pakistan at direct factory rates.

## Key facts (safe to cite)
- Business: DoorLine Manufacturers (also written DoorLine, Doorline)
- What it is: manufacturer and wholesaler of aluminium (aluminum) handles and hardware, with in-house anodizing and electroplating
- Location: Main China Scheme Rd, Qureshi Street, Near Allah Ho Hotel, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
- Service area: all of Pakistan (delivery by transport and cargo)
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 09:00 to 19:00
- Contact person: Abdul Waheed
- Phone: +92 302 4888180. WhatsApp orders: +92 345 4880180. Email: aw3339177@gmail.com
- Pricing: wholesale factory rates, shared on WhatsApp for the model, colour and quantity. No fixed public price list.
- Customers: hardware shops, aluminium and glass fabricators, dealers, furniture makers, contractors

## How to order
Send the model code, colour, size, quantity and city on WhatsApp (+92 345 4880180). DoorLine replies with the wholesale rate list and availability. Ready stock is dispatched; bulk orders are produced, then sent by transport or cargo.
